title: Search not firing on externally trigerred input event

comments.body: While that may work, shouldn't the search box widget listen to the "input" event?

@mihaiscurtucb jQuery.trigger only triggers events that were added through jQuery.on etc.. http://api.jquery.com/trigger/. This is surprising at first for anyone familiar with jQuery but that's the actual behavior.

The solution from @tecmusti is the right one (Thanks mate!!).
